name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 8 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-01-29, at wavelengths from 0.91 to 4.55 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
